title: Lotte Hi-Mart to deploy humanoid robots in logistics centre by 2028
key_facts: Lotte Global Logistics was selected for a national KEIT project (Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources) on physical-AI humanoid robots for logistics, running to March 2031.
Partners: Yujin Robot, CISO and the Korea Electronics Technology Institute; Lotte Himart joins as a demand-side company.
Pilots at Jincheon, Yangsan and Icheon logistics centres cover six processes, including sorter operations, picking, packing and patrol.
Aim: reduce reliance on foreign-made robots and AI models.
Last year Lotte piloted an AI bipedal humanoid on apparel picking and packing at Jincheon.
quote_evidence: Lotte Global Logistics will develop and pilot domestic physical artificial intelligence (AI)-based Humanoid Robot technology tailored to logistics sites.
Lotte Himart will also join as a demand-side company.
why_it_matters_hint: A government-backed five-year pilot of humanoid robots in Korean warehouses.
notes: Global Sources page rate-limited (429). Its headline says Lotte Hi-Mart will deploy humanoid robots by 2028; Chosunbiz text read instead does not mention 2028, so no 2028 date is stated in the entry.
